speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: CT Urogram with contrast. Given the ultrasound findings of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts alongside your recurrent UTIs and hematuria, do you have a history of smoking or chronic kidney stones?

text: RESULTS: CT Urogram: No significant findings; confirms previous ultrasound results showing multiple cysts in the collecting ducts without evidence of malignancy or acute obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The imaging findings of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla, combined with your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and hematuria, are characteristic of this condition. The negative CT for malignancy or obstruction supports a benign structural anomaly.
